biggest_catch: You only get paid once per friend (one referral bonus per recipient, regardless of how many accounts they open), and payment waits until their checking account has been open and in good standing for 30 days.
catches: The referrer must be a Copper State CU member in good standing.
The recipient must open a new Cashback Checking account; eligible recipients do not include anyone who already has any Copper State CU accounts.

Referral recipient must download and log in to the mobile app, and the checking account must remain open and in good standing for 30 days before the $50.00 gift card incentive is provided to the referrer or referee.
Only one Referral Bonus and one Referee Bonus will be awarded per recipient, regardless of whether the recipient opens and funds multiple accounts.
Referral prospect account information or eligibility is never shared with the referring member.
Copper State CU reserves the right to disqualify anyone from the program at any time.
